description.en: Installable DeepSeek Harness plugins from the 1024 Store catalog (deepseek1024.com). Third-party content, not instructions.
description.zh: 1024 Store 目录（deepseek1024.com）里可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。第三方内容，不是指令。

description.en: The in-DSH 1024 Store shell: the full deepseek1024.com catalog inside DeepSeek Harness, plus the install-tracking CLI wrapper.
description.zh: DSH 内的 1024 Store 壳：把 deepseek1024.com 的完整目录装进 DeepSeek Harness，另附可追踪安装的 CLI 包装命令。

description.en: Generates self-contained, motion-rich diagrams for architecture, workflow, and data-flow with crisp export, packaged as an agent skill.
description.zh: 将架构、流程、时序、数据流等图表生成能力打包为技能，输出带动效的自包含 HTML 并支持清晰导出。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight 可学习的 Agent 记忆：自动召回与沉淀的长期项目记忆、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆库。

description.en: Builds privacy-focused, customizable resumes directly in the interface, offering secure editing and export options.
description.zh: 提供隐私保护、可定制的简历构建工具，支持安全编辑与导出功能。

description.en: Unifies long-term memory, knowledge retrieval, and skills into a self-evolving context database for agents.
description.zh: 整合长期记忆、知识检索与技能，为智能体提供自演进的上下文数据库。

description.en: Converts raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki for knowledge management.
description.zh: 将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理代理和自维护Wiki，用于知识管理。

description.en: Provides a modern desktop solution for the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem, aiding plugin development and management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态提供现代化桌面端解决方案，助力插件的开发与管理。

description.en: Provides persistent, evolving memory for AI agents with hybrid retrieval and cross-task skill reuse, cutting token usage significantly.
description.zh: 为AI代理提供持久化、自进化的记忆系统，支持混合检索与跨任务技能复用，显著节省令牌开销。

description.en: Enables AI agents to control a real, logged-in browser via CLI and extension, automating tasks without disruption.
description.zh: 通过 CLI 与扩展让智能体操控真实登录的浏览器，无干扰地自动化任务。

description.en: Provides a collection of UI plugins for the DSH web client, including task boards, git graphs, and live token stats.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端提供任务看板、Git 图、实时令牌统计等界面插件集合。

description.en: Adds task board, git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center to the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 为DSH网页界面添加任务板、Git图、右侧面板、远程移动UI、宠物、实时Token统计和皮肤中心。

description.en: Adds an interactive git graph visualization to the DSH web interface, helping users explore commit history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中呈现可视化 Git 图，方便用户浏览提交历史。

description.en: Provides internationalization utilities for the DeepSeek Harness web plugin ecosystem, supporting translations across the workshop.
description.zh: 为插件生态提供国际化与翻译支持，方便多语言界面开发。

description.en: Adds a decorative companion element to the DSH web interface, providing playful interaction and visual appeal.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加装饰性陪伴元素，提供趣味互动与视觉点缀。

description.en: Renders a marketplace interface for discovering and installing community plugins.
description.zh: 渲染创意工坊界面，供用户发现并安装社区插件。

description.en: Introduces a virtual pet to the DSH web interface, offering playful interactions and visual engagement for users.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中引入虚拟宠物，为用户提供趣味互动与视觉陪伴。

description.en: Manages client-side plugins for DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to install, enable, or remove extensions easily.
description.zh: 管理DeepSeek Harness客户端插件，支持用户轻松安装、启用或移除扩展。

description.en: Enables remote access to the DSH web interface from mobile devices, allowing control and monitoring on the go.
description.zh: 支持从移动设备远程访问 DSH 网页界面，随时随地控制与监控。

description.en: Archives, stores, and organizes entire sessions for later retrieval, ensuring conversation history is preserved and accessible.
description.zh: 归档并存储整个会话，便于日后检索，确保对话历史得以保存和访问。

description.en: Displays or manages the current session identifier within the user interface.
description.zh: 在界面中显示或管理当前会话标识。

description.en: Provides a dedicated interface for browsing and managing skills within the DSH web client.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页客户端提供技能浏览与管理的专用界面。

description.en: Enables remote shell access and command execution through the DSH web interface, facilitating system management.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 网页界面实现远程 Shell 访问与命令执行，便于系统管理。

description.en: Adds a task board view to the DSH web interface, helping users organize and track work items visually.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中添加任务看板视图，帮助用户可视化组织与追踪工作项。

description.en: Provides a tool for describing images via the DSH interface, enabling automated visual content analysis.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 界面提供图像描述工具，实现自动化视觉内容分析。

description.en: A web plugin ecosystem pack for DeepSeek Harness, aggregating various UI enhancements and tools via a creative workshop distribution channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 聚合多种界面增强与工具插件的 Web 生态包，通过创意工坊分发。

description.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single package for comprehensive interface enhancement.
description.zh: 聚合所有 Web 界面组件，提供全面的界面增强。

description.en: Provides a settings panel for users to customize web UI preferences and options.
description.zh: 提供设置面板，让用户自定义 Web 界面偏好和选项。

description.en: Acts as a central hub for browsing and applying skins within the DSH web interface, simplifying theme management.
description.zh: 作为 DSH 网页界面的皮肤中心，集中浏览与应用主题，简化管理。

description.en: Integrates a design studio into the AI workspace, enabling editable design creation and collaborative workflows.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成设计工作室，支持可编辑设计与协作流程。

description.en: Adds presentation creation capabilities to the AI workspace, allowing users to design and edit slides.
description.zh: 为 AI 工作区添加演示文稿制作功能，用户可设计与编辑幻灯片。

description.en: Integrates video editing tools into the AI workspace, supporting creation and modification of video content.
description.zh: 在 AI 工作区中集成视频编辑工具，支持创建与修改视频内容。

description.en: Adds an interactive whale character to the DSH interface that monitors account balance with animations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）一只住在 DSH 界面右下角的小鲸鱼娘，帮你盯着DeepSeek账户余额。QQ弹弹，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转、数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用，建议直接喊来你的dsh安装

description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash provider 替换为 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令运行在挂载资源上（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres），支持按挂载读/写/执行模式、按命令的沙箱路由（monty、pyodide、quickjs 进程内；docker、e2b、daytona 远程），并可在虚拟终端把已安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws 或自注册）作为起始词使用。

description.en: A memory management kit that helps agents remember, refine, and recall user information across sessions for personalized interactions.
description.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话记忆管理，帮助记住、优化并回忆用户信息，实现个性化交互。

description.en: Provides the main desktop UI shell for the DeepSeek Harness Tauri app, including window layout and basic controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供主界面框架，包括窗口布局和基本控件。

description.en: Implements the central panel interface for the Tauri desktop app, hosting the chat view and interactive components.
description.zh: 实现桌面版的核心面板界面，承载对话视图和交互组件。

description.en: Adds extendable UI components to the Tauri panel, allowing dynamic content and custom views within the interface.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供可扩展的界面组件，支持动态内容和自定义视图。

description.en: Provides a placeholder UI element for the Tauri panel, used for layout spacing and structural purposes.
description.zh: 为桌面面板提供占位界面元素，用于布局间距和结构用途。

description.en: Enables right-click context menu actions within the Tauri desktop app for quick access to common commands.
description.zh: 在桌面版中启用右键菜单操作，方便快速访问常用命令。

description.en: Manages chat sessions and message history within the Tauri desktop app, supporting multiple concurrent conversations.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的聊天会话和消息历史，支持多个并发对话。

description.en: Provides the core UI components and styling for the Tauri desktop app, including buttons, inputs, and visual elements.
description.zh: 为桌面版提供核心 UI 组件和样式，包括按钮、输入框和视觉元素。

description.en: Manages workspace and worktree state in the Tauri desktop app, handling file and project context for sessions.
description.zh: 管理桌面版中的工作区和工作树状态，处理会话的文件和项目上下文。

description.en: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and a review panel.
description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回与审阅面板。

description.en: Adds a Context Insight panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI showing what the model's context window currently holds and how it evolved: composition against window size, per-request history, compaction and injection events, and message-level token counts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加上下文洞察面板，展示模型上下文窗口当前的构成与演变过程：各部分占比与窗口大小对照、按请求的历史趋势、压缩与注入事件，以及消息级 token 统计。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: Connects IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials across eight chat platforms.
description.zh: 通过扫码或机器人凭据把IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord和WhatsApp）。 Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials (8 channels).

description.en: Lets users access their local DeepSeek Harness web instance from a phone via QR code, syncing over LAN or public network.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 25 transparent animations, screen wandering, click reactions and drag, plus a reproducible asset-generation pipeline.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌宠：25 组透明动画、屏幕漫游、点击互动与拖拽，附可复现的素材生成流水线。

description.en: Provides a local-first AI novel writing workbench with outlines, chapters, and revision tools.
description.zh: 提供本地优先的 AI 小说创作工作台，包含大纲、章节和修订工具。

description.en: Switches Wallpaper Engine wallpapers and adjusts blur, brightness, border, and glass effects for a more polished look.
description.zh: 一个插件让你的dsh可以自由切换你的wallpaper engine里面的壁纸资源，还可以通过多个滑动条来控制透壁纸的模糊程度，亮度，边框，以及对话框的液态玻璃效果，让你的dsh更加美观

description.en: Desktop companion platform with animated pets and coding-agent integrations, adding playful interactive characters to your workspace.
description.zh: 桌面伴侣平台，带动画宠物与编程代理集成，为工作区增添趣味互动角色。

description.en: Offers unlimited long-term memory for AI assistants, enabling context retention across sessions and tasks.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供无限长期记忆，跨会话和任务保持上下文连贯。

description.en: Search your past AI coding sessions — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 17 more. Indexes the session history they already wrote to disk, including months from before you installed it, and recalls it in any of them. No LLM, no embeddings, one local Go binary.
description.zh: 索引并搜索多个 AI 编程工具的会话历史，无需向量嵌入即可回溯过往工作。

description.en: Provides a self-hosted, human-in-the-loop task manager for agents, enabling real-time control from mobile, web, or desktop.
description.zh: 提供自托管的真人介入任务管理器，支持从移动端、网页或桌面实时控制智能体。

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

description.en: Provides CloudBase backend services including database, authentication, and function execution for AI agents.
description.zh: 为AI代理提供云开发后端服务，涵盖数据库、认证和函数执行。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 零配置地将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Integrates a multimodal workflow studio into DeepSeek Harness, enabling visual canvas-based automation and Python plugin execution.
description.zh: 将多模态工作流工作室集成到DeepSeek Harness，支持可视化画布编排与Python插件执行。

description.en: Generates image candidates, supports conversational character card editing, scenario mode, and material extraction for text-based games.
description.zh: 生成候选项，支持对话式人物卡编辑、剧本模式与素材抽取。

description.en: Presents a one-stop AI commercialization desktop client built on Jingyun Studio and DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 Jingyun Studio 与 DeepSeek Harness 打造的一站式 AI 商业化桌面客户端。

description.en: One-command install and free to use; paste an image to see and ask. Provides a nearly seamless multimodal experience for text-only models, supporting image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI restoration, element grounding, pixel diff, and more.
description.zh: 一键安装、免费使用；粘贴图片即可看图问答。为纯文本模型提供近乎无缝的多模态体验，支持图片问答、多图比较、长图 OCR、截图到前端 UI 还原、元素定位、像素对比等。

description.en: Provides the AionUI panel for DeepSeek Harness desktop client, enhancing the user interface with a dedicated panel.
description.zh: 为桌面客户端提供AionUI面板，增强界面交互功能。

description.en: Displays real-time statistics and live metrics within the client interface for monitoring activity.
description.zh: 在客户端界面中展示实时统计和活动指标，便于监控。

description.en: Applies visual skins and themes to the desktop client, changing its appearance.
description.zh: 为桌面客户端应用视觉皮肤和主题，改变其外观。

description.en: Combines all web UI components into a single package for the desktop client interface.
description.zh: 将桌面客户端的全部Web界面组件整合为一个包。

description.en: Applies a QQ 2006 retro visual theme to the client interface, evoking classic chat aesthetics.
description.zh: 为客户端界面应用QQ2006怀旧主题，唤起经典聊天风格。

description.en: Applies a QQ 98 retro visual theme to the client interface, offering a vintage look.
description.zh: 为客户端界面应用QQ98怀旧主题，提供复古外观。

description.en: Provides a theme skin styled after a securities trading interface for the desktop client.
description.zh: 为桌面客户端提供证券交易风格的界面皮肤。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: Provides undo functionality for savepoints in the DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness界面提供保存点的撤销功能。

description.en: A marketplace plugin for discovering and installing DeepSeek Harness extensions.
description.zh: 用于发现和安装DeepSeek Harness扩展的插件市场。

description.en: Bundles the DeepSeek Harness CLI with a desktop client for Windows, enabling one-click launch and usage.
description.zh: 打包 DeepSeek Harness 命令行工具，提供 Windows 桌面客户端，一键启动使用。

description.en: Provides a customizable navigation bar for the application.
description.zh: 提供可定制的应用导航栏。

description.en: Controls the reasoning effort level of the AI model.
description.zh: 控制AI模型的推理努力程度。

description.en: Manages chat sessions, including creation, switching, and deletion.
description.zh: 管理聊天会话，包括创建、切换和删除。

description.en: Connects different parts of the system, possibly automating workflows.
description.zh: 连接系统各部分，可能自动化工作流。

description.en: Provides a visual marketplace for browsing, searching, and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins, updated daily with curated content.
description.zh: 提供可视化插件市场，支持浏览、搜索和安装，每日更新精选内容。

description.en: Packages the DeepSeek Harness desktop companion into an installable Electron app for macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣打包为 macOS 和 Windows 的可安装 Electron 应用。

description.en: Provides an experimental agent team profile for the DeepSeek Harness development environment.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 开发环境提供实验性的 agent 团队配置。

description.en: Offers an experimental web-based profile for agent teams in the DeepSeek Harness development environment.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 开发环境提供基于 web 的实验性 agent 团队配置。

description.en: Base package containing core UI components and runtime for the desktop companion.
description.zh: 桌面伴侣的基础包，包含核心界面组件与运行时。

description.en: Headless runtime package for running the desktop companion without a graphical interface.
description.zh: 无界面运行桌面伴侣的运行时包。

description.en: Provides a development kit for building and bundling DeepSeek Harness desktop companion applications.
description.zh: 提供用于构建和打包 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣应用的开发套件。

description.en: Offers a minimal development toolkit for creating lightweight DeepSeek Harness desktop companion builds.
description.zh: 提供用于创建轻量级 DeepSeek Harness 桌面伴侣构建的最小开发工具包。

description.en: Web application bundle providing the full user interface for the desktop companion.
description.zh: 提供桌面伴侣完整用户界面的网页应用包。

description.en: Adds a lively working-line activity display to the terminal interface.
description.zh: 在终端界面中展示活跃的工作线活动状态。

description.en: Adds an editable context canvas to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Open local agent sessions as graphs, connect selected material to a question, and run canvas questions with the harness's models or agent. Includes local conversation lookup tools.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中加入可编辑的上下文画布。将本地 Agent 会话打开为图，把选定材料连入问题，并使用 Harness 的模型或 Agent 在画布上提问。附带本地会话检索工具。

description.en: Coordinates distributed agents for living, connecting, executing, and evolving together as an orchestration platform.
description.zh: 协调分布式代理的协作平台，让多个代理共同生活、连接、执行与进化。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Offers a specialized penetration testing mode for DeepSeek Harness, targeting security assessments.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的渗透测试模式  @CloverSecLabs

description.en: Deep Mnemon integration: local three-tier memory (Runtime Memory, retrievable Documents, supervised Memory Spaces).
description.zh: Mnemon 深度集成：本地三层记忆（Runtime Memory、可检索 Documents、受监督 Memory Spaces）。

description.en: Automatically captures and stores runtime context and project documents for persistent, searchable memory across sessions.
description.zh: 自动捕获运行时上下文和项目文档，实现跨会话的持久化、可搜索记忆。

description.en: Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: Scopes memory capture to specific projects or sessions, enabling targeted and organized long-term recall.
description.zh: 将记忆捕获限定在特定项目或会话内，实现精准且有组织的长期回顾。

description.en: Create, edit, inspect, and deliver spreadsheets, documents, presentations, databases, and canvases in DeepSeek Harness, with live preview and worktree review.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑、检查和交付表格、文档、演示文稿、多维表格和画布，支持实时预览与 worktree 审阅。

description.en: A research workbench for LaTeX compilation, arXiv management, experiment tracking, metrics charts, and SSH task orchestration.
description.zh: 科研工作台，支持 LaTeX 编译、arXiv 管理、实验追踪、指标图表和 SSH 任务编排。

description.zh: 集成 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key 即可在 DSH 中使用。

description.en: Provides a plugin marketplace within DSH to search, download, and install community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for browsing, learning, and sending categorized meme images.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 表情包插件：浏览、学习并发送分类表情包。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.

description.en: Orchestrates multiple AI agents in departmental roles to execute long-form complex tasks, mitigating hallucination across research pipelines.

description.en: Connect locally signed-in Trae models to DeepSeek Harness with a read-only credits overview.

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool (multi-account rotation, live credits and model catalog).

description.en: Governs AI agent tasks by aligning goals, planning, and verifying delivery through orchestration.

description.zh: DSH远程Web启动插件，支持用户名密码认证。

description.en: Turns important conversation items into trackable plans and reminders for follow-up.

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面应用《你的名字》电影主题，改变配色与视觉风格。

description.en: Provides real-time live statistics updates in the user interface, displaying dynamic metrics and activity data as they occur.
description.zh: 在用户界面中实时更新统计信息，动态展示指标和活动数据。

description.zh: 提供预制与自定义提示词模板调色板，支持一键插入与智能建议卡。

description.en: Applies custom visual skins to transform the overall look and feel of the interface with different color schemes and styles.
description.zh: 应用自定义视觉皮肤，通过不同配色和风格改变界面整体外观。

description.en: Provides SSH connectivity tools, enabling secure remote terminal sessions and server management from within the application.
description.zh: 提供 SSH 连接工具，支持在应用内进行安全远程终端会话和服务器管理。

description.en: Displays a task board interface for visualizing and managing tasks in a kanban-style layout.
description.zh: 以看板式布局展示任务板界面，用于可视化和管理任务。

description.en: Shows a usage dashboard with charts and metrics tracking resource consumption and activity patterns.
description.zh: 展示使用情况仪表盘，用图表和指标跟踪资源消耗和活动模式。

description.en: Aggregates all web UI components into a single bundle for unified deployment and consistent interface enhancement.
description.zh: 将所有 Web UI 组件聚合为单一包，便于统一部署和一致的界面增强。

description.en: Provides a settings panel for configuring web UI preferences, appearance, and interface behavior.
description.zh: 提供设置面板，用于配置 Web UI 偏好、外观和界面行为。

description.en: Applies a Miku-themed skin featuring vocaloid-inspired colors and anime-styled visual design.

description.en: Applies a Minecraft-themed skin with blocky, pixelated visuals and game-inspired color palette.
description.zh: 应用我的世界主题皮肤，采用方块像素视觉和游戏风格配色。

description.en: Provides a centralized hub for browsing, selecting, and managing available visual skins.
description.zh: 提供集中中心，用于浏览、选择和管理可用视觉皮肤。

description.en: Applies a THS-themed skin with specialized financial data styling and trading-oriented visuals.
description.zh: 应用 THS 主题皮肤，采用专业金融数据风格和交易导向视觉。

description.en: Applies a trading-themed skin with market-oriented colors and financial dashboard aesthetics.
description.zh: 应用交易主题皮肤，采用市场导向配色和金融仪表盘美学。

description.en: Applies a whale song theme with oceanic tones and serene, flowing visual design elements.
description.zh: 应用鲸歌主题，采用海洋色调和宁静流动的视觉设计元素。

description.en: Applies an XP-themed skin with retro Windows-style visuals and nostalgic interface styling.
description.zh: 应用 XP 主题皮肤，采用复古 Windows 风格视觉和怀旧界面风格。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness into Feishu/Lark, enabling streaming cards, workspaces, parallel tasks, and in-chat management.
description.zh: dsh-lark-bot：把 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 桥接进飞书/Lark 的 bot：流式卡片、项目工作区、并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理与安全网守护（dsh 崩溃后飞书仍可自救）。A bridge bot connecting DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into Feishu/Lark: streaming cards, workspaces, parallel tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian.

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness — QR one-click auth, multi-mode agents, card-based commands, zero-loss outbox, media in/out, session-log doctor, reusable DSH Web GUI
description.zh: 连接飞书/ Lark，支持扫码认证、多模式 Agent、卡片命令与可靠消息收发。

description.en: Recalls the exact state at the time a message was sent, enabling message recall in DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: DSH 消息撤回插件：回到发送该消息时的状态 DSH Message Recall Plugin: Return to the state when the message was sent

description.en: A right-side file tree panel that allows clicking or dragging files into the input field.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工作区文件资源管理器:右侧目录树面板,点击/拖拽文件引用进输入框,UI 对齐 DSH 原生风格 | Workspace file explorer plugin for DeepSeek Harness: right-side file tree panel, click or drag file references into the composer, native DSH look

description.en: Configurable DSH web-surface plugin: wallpaper & frosted-glass themes, accent colors, custom keyboard shortcuts, app-usage panel, history strip, message Markdown — zero shell edits.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 界面，包含壁纸、主题、快捷键和布局调整，无需修改外壳。

description.en: Offers a trading research workbench with typed market data, deterministic indicators, and interactive chart cards, strictly for analysis.
description.zh: 提供交易研究工作台，含类型化市场数据、确定性指标和交互式图表卡片，仅供研究。

description.en: Displays a selection-scoped explanation sidebar for DeepSeek Harness conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供选中内容解释的侧边栏。

description.en: Claude Code-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness agents, as an out-of-tree dsh plugin bundle
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 代理提供 Claude Code 风格终端界面，作为可安装插件包。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web plugin
description.zh: 允许局域网内设备访问 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin for Better DeepSeek Chrome extension.
description.zh: 连接 DeepSeek Harness 与 Better DeepSeek 浏览器扩展，启用增强的聊天功能。

description.en: DSH plugin: Git Bash shell for all agent modes on Windows (replaces pwsh executor)
description.zh: 为Windows上的所有代理模式提供Git Bash shell执行器，替代默认的PowerShell。

description.en: A personal workbench with calendar, task list, and AI-assisted planning and execution.
description.zh: DSH 个人工作台：日历 + 任务列表 + AI 澄清/拆解/执行/复盘 | Personal workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web: calendar + task list + AI assistant

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Display-layer translation for the DSH Web UI: renders thinking chains (chain-of-thought), task cards and answers in one of 8 target languages, with local Ollama or Google/Bing providers and originals preserved.
description.zh: DSH Web 显示层翻译：将思考链、任务卡片与回答以 8 种目标语言之一显示，支持本地 Ollama 或 Google/Bing，原文完整保留。

description.en: Tracks token usage, cache hits, billing peaks, and balance, with CSV/JSON/PNG export capabilities.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量与消耗插件（dsh-usage-plugin）—— 每次调用的 token 用量/缓存命中统计、峰谷计费、余额查询、CSV/JSON/PNG 导出，可经桌面端一键安装或命令行 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Let agents search, read, and cite your local Zotero library: find papers, browse notes and annotations, pull evidence by question, open the source document, generate citations.
description.zh: 让代理搜索、阅读并引用本地 Zotero 文献库，包括论文、笔记、注释与引用。

description.en: A multi-agent framework for solving math problems with formal verification.

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ, enabling rich media sending, multiple bots, scheduled messages, and sticker management.

description.zh: Web UI 俄语本地化：在 设置 - 通用 - 语言 中增加第三个选项，并在运行时翻译核心与插件的语言命名空间。

description.en: Provides a multi-agent math modeling plugin with five role presets and 33 model-library skills.
description.zh: UltraMath 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解 DSH 插件: 5 角色预设 + 33 篇模型库技能 + SKILL.md 主入口 (plugin_check pass)

description.en: DSH voice input plugin: tap Alt to talk, get text in composer. Web Speech default (zero config), optional OpenAI-compatible ASR, polish via DSH LLM.

description.zh: 将图片转为像素文本供纯文本模型读取，提供 OCR 和采样工具。

description.en: Automatically pauses and resumes long-running tasks based on user-defined time windows.
description.zh: 根据用户自定义时间窗口自动暂停和恢复长时间任务。

description.en: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.
description.zh: 跨实例互联：经 interconnect 服务在多个 DSH 实例间转发消息与事件。

description.en: Persists project memory by summarizing sessions and injecting lessons into future runs.
description.zh: DSH 项目持久化记忆插件（TypeScript）：会话归纳 + 经验教训沉淀，写入 PROJECT_MEMORY.md 与全局索引；每轮工作结束自动提醒蒸馏、自动注入未来 AGENTS；附 Web GUI 记忆面板（项目/全局 tab、检索、手动记录/删除）。dsh-plugin

description.en: DSH 实现 workbuddy 同款选择 skill 功能 | WorkBuddy-style skill picker for DeepSeek Harness: pick a skill in the composer, insert the official /skill-name gesture, and DSH loads it with your message.
description.zh: 在输入框选择技能并插入官方技能指令以加载。

description.en: Enables SSH operations from chat with high-risk command protection and side terminal.

description.en: Provides fireworks-related tools for DSH, offering utility functions for terminal users.

description.zh: 提供38个学术研究工具，涵盖Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv及引用功能。
